title: 沃什杰克逊霍尔重磅承诺，专家解读市场反应
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I love his commitment once again to the 2% inflation target, reiterating that that's something the Fed is laser focused on and not backing away from.
segments.zh: 我欣赏他再次承诺2%的通胀目标，重申美联储对此高度专注，不会退缩。

segments.en: And I think that you're seeing this sort of stability in the equity markets because we got what we needed from this speech.
segments.zh: 我认为你看到权益市场的这种稳定，是因为我们从这次演讲中得到了所需的信息。

segments.en: I think he made some very important points about the framework of monetary policy.
segments.zh: 我认为他就货币政策框架提出了一些非常重要的观点。

segments.en: I think he made very important points about forward guidance and how he's thinking about it.
segments.zh: 我认为他就前瞻性指引及其思考方式提出了非常重要的观点。

segments.en: So I commend it because I think it was a real speech, a real substance. I think as people are looking at this inflation data, it is not turning in the direction that the committee had hoped.
segments.zh: 我对此表示赞赏，因为我认为这是一次真正的演讲，内容充实。我认为人们看待这些通胀数据时，它并未朝着委员会希望的方向发展。

segments.en: It is continuing, not only to be sticky, but to press forward.
segments.zh: 它不仅在持续，而且还在向前推进。

segments.en: I think we need to put some restriction into policy and so I believe it's time to act.
segments.zh: 我认为我们需要在政策中施加一些限制，所以我相信是时候采取行动了。

segments.en: I think the work to do quote that you mentioned is the money quote and I think that it delivered the reaction at the chair.
segments.zh: 我认为你提到的那个关键引语就是核心，而且它引发了主席的反应。
